audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: every sentence of the deciding quotation is verbatim in the held Hardin 2002 text at the stated pages (sec. 2.2.4 p.13; sec. 5.4.1.2 p.71), and the supporting OPD p.3 and May & Loeweke sec. 4 p.12 statements are verbatim in the held files; only the bracketed section label is editorial. (2) The coding rests on the fullest existing description (Hardin 2002, 175-pp SIL grammar sketch) plus both SIL phonology documents; all three independently give the same facts: stress 'contrastive', every Maia pair = singular vs plural person prefix, plural prefix takes initial primary stress, sometimes realized as length before vowel-initial stems. MORPHOLOGICAL (affix identity fixes stress) is the right house reading; the SIL label 'phonemic' is compatible (lexically stressed plural prefixes) and no monomorphemic Maia minimal pair exists in any source reached.
